amp.name: Contact: part of your network
amp.narrative: An important person to the character and an integral part of its Network. Can be used to enrich the narrative or to shape how the result of a Network Test is interpreted.

amp.name: Contact: reliable in one domain
amp.narrative: An important person to the character who—through their influence, reliability, and/or willingness—helps reduce the risk of complications when acquiring gear or sensitive information.

amp.name: Contact: several domains
amp.narrative: Same as above, but in addition, the contact operates in several domains.

amp.name: Contact: influential and reliable
amp.narrative: This contact is probably both very influential and reliable and/or is also willing to take certain risks on behalf of the PC.

amp.name: Contact: extremely influential
amp.narrative: This contact is extremely influential and reliable in its field, and on top of that, they must really like the PC…

amp.name: Contact: knows everyone
amp.narrative: A contact who knows a lot of people in all circles. Probably a Fixer, a Star with a vast network, or someone in a high-ranking position. They may, however, be very busy and not always available, which explains why they only provide

amp.name: Contact: knows everyone, strong in one field
amp.narrative: This contact knows people everywhere—especially in one particular field— and is willing to use that network for the PC when needed.

amp.name: Adrenaline addict
amp.narrative: The character loves taking risks and may spend 1 Edge point to gain an Advantage when taking a High or Extreme Risk. Note: may also be played as a disposition rather than a quality.

amp.name: Allergy
amp.narrative: Allows recovering 1 Edge point in exchange for a Disadvantage on Tests when the chosen allergen is present.

amp.name: Analytical mind
amp.narrative: May gain an Advantage on Logic Tests when analyzing clues, patterns, or solving puzzles. Note: may also be played as a disposition rather than a quality.

amp.name: AR Vertigo
amp.narrative: The character poorly tolerates AR overflow. When too much information appears, they suffer nausea and vertigo and take Disadvantage until they shut off their AR; doing so grants 1 Edge point.

amp.name: Asthmatic
amp.narrative: Allows recovering 1 Edge point in exchange for a Disadvantage when overexerting or in polluted/dusty environments due to an asthma attack.

amp.name: Astral chameleon
amp.narrative: The character’s aura is shifting and harder to identify. Their astral signature is more difficult to recognize.

amp.name: Brand loyalty
amp.narrative: May gain Advantage in exchange for 1 Edge point when using a device from their favorite brand. Note: may also be played as a disposition rather than a quality.

amp.name: Bruiser
amp.narrative: DV+1 on unarmed attacks. Note: watch compatibility with other DV amps (+2 max).

amp.name: Contortionist
amp.narrative: Allows escaping bonds or passing through tight spaces in exchange for 1 Edge point. Note: may also be played as a disposition rather than a quality.

amp.name: Cyberware tolerance
amp.narrative: The last point of Essence counts double, allowing one more implant before death (penalties still apply normally).

amp.name: Eagle Eyed
amp.narrative: Incompatible with cyber eyes.

amp.name: Famous
amp.narrative: Congratulations, you are famous and recognized in at least one community. You may gain Edge points for being recognized at the worst possible moment, or spend them to obtain favors when being recognized helps.

amp.name: Focused concentration
amp.narrative: +1 max sustained spell without Disadvantage, +1 with Disadvantage. Note: watch compatibility (max +2)

amp.name: Geas
amp.narrative: Allows an awakened character to ignore the loss of one Essence point regarding their magical abilities (magical penalties therefore start at an Essence of 4 or less, instead of 5 or less) in exchange for restrictions on their magic use (e.g., only in the street, must be in astral perception, must make broad gestures without restraint, only at night). Affects all magical activities and must not replicate a limitation the character already possesses. Suffers the normal effects of Essence loss as well as a disadvantage on Magic-related tests if the restrictions are not respected.

amp.name: Glass Bones
amp.narrative: May gain 1 Edge point in exchange for taking a Light Wound when resisting damage (regardless of whether the damage already causes a wound).

amp.name: Gremlins
amp.narrative: Commlinks crash, guns jam, electronics short out… it happens constantly. May gain 1 Edge point when it happens at the wrong time. May spend 1 Edge point to have it happen at the right time. Note: may also be played as a disposition rather than a quality.

amp.name: Gun fu
amp.narrative: The character has mastered a martial art specializing in firearms in close combat (CQC, Firefight, Okichitaw, Gun Kata): On a successful Close Combat test, may spend 1 Edge point to disarm and steal the opponent’s weapon instead of dealing damage.

amp.name: Hard-boiled
amp.narrative: Note: incompatible with other Armor-increasing traits.

amp.name: Hardening
amp.narrative: Matrix Armor +1 Not stackable with other matrix armor assets.

amp.name: Human-looking
amp.narrative: The character is a small ork or a tall dwarf who can pass for a human.

amp.name: Intimidating scars
amp.narrative: May gain Advantage on Intimidation Tests in exchange for 1 Edge point when scars are visible. May also gain 1 Edge point in exchange for a Disadvantage on a Charisma- related Test.

amp.name: Lip reading
amp.narrative: Allow you to… read on the lips for one Edge point.

amp.name: Long reach
amp.narrative: Extends close range from 2 to 3 meters when using Close Combat.

amp.name: Lost in translation

amp.name: Magic resistance
amp.narrative: In exchange for an Edge Point, the character gains an Advantage on a test to resist a spell (or imposes a Disadvantage on the caster if there is no opposed test).

amp.name: Beast’s Way
amp.narrative: Choose an animal totem or an idol and apply the Disposition and Effects of one of the Mentor Spirit’s RR.

amp.name: Aid Sorcery
amp.narrative: When in contact with a sorcerer, the character can grant them a RR 1 Sorcery.

amp.name: Berserk
amp.narrative: The character can enter a state of frenzied rage: +2 to unarmed or melee weapon’s DV. Must take a high or extreme risk. The power ends if the character cannot attack for an entire turn. The character suffers a Light Wound once the power ends.

amp.name: Blind Fighting
amp.narrative: Cancels any Disadvantage in combat related to visibility.

amp.name: Cloak
amp.narrative: It imposes a Disadvantage on characters who would attempt to read the target’s aura.

amp.name: Concealment
amp.narrative: Allows you to blend in the crowd during a scene for one Edge point.

amp.name: Countermagic
amp.narrative: In exchange for an Edge Point, the character gains an Advantage on a test to resist a spell (or imposes a Disadvantage on the caster if there is no opposed test).

amp.name: Counterstrike
amp.narrative: In exchange for an Edge Point, the character gains an Advantage on a Close Combat Test when defending while attempting to deal damage to the attacker.

amp.name: Danger sense
amp.narrative: Allows you to sense an imminent threat without any Perception Test; however, no further details are provided.

amp.name: Delay Damage
amp.narrative: Delays the application of damage from an unarmed attack. The attack acts and counts as a sustained spell, with the damage only being applied when the adept ceases to maintain the power (maximum 24 hours). Because the Attack is attached to the aura, a mage with astral perception can make a Counterspelling Test to negate successes on the Attack Test and thus attempt to render the attack harmless.

amp.name: Distance Strike
amp.narrative: Allows you to make a unarmed attack at short range with a Disadvantage.

amp.name: Elemental Strike
amp.narrative: Elemental effect (fire, ice, acid, etc. chosen when gaining the Amp) for one Edge point.

amp.name: Easy Healing
amp.narrative: Allows you to gain an Advantage on Survival (First Aid) Tests given to the character in exchange for one Edge point.

amp.name: Elemental Weapon
amp.narrative: Elemental effect (fire, ice, acid, etc.; chosen when gaining the Amp) for one Edge point.

amp.name: Empathic Awareness
amp.narrative: Thanks to a limited form of magical awareness, the character can feel the emotions of anyone they see through normal sight. On a successful Perception (Astral) (3) Test, allows knowing a target's emotional state without using astral perception.

amp.name: Empathic Healing
amp.narrative: In exchange for one Edge point, the character can transfer another character's injury to their own status monitor.

amp.name: Enhanced Perception
amp.narrative: Each additional rating (+5,000¥) allows you to choose an additional narrative effect (night vision, thermographic vision, wide-range hearing, canine sense of smell, echolocation, etc.).

amp.name: Flash Running
amp.narrative: Once per scene, can perform 2 movements in a single Narration.

amp.name: Flexibility
amp.narrative: Allows you to break free from your bonds or pass through narrow, normally inaccessible passages in exchange for an Edge point.

amp.name: Freefall
amp.narrative: Adds 3 meters to the height from which the character can jump without risking injury (this Amp can be taken up to level 3 for 15,000¥ and a height of 9 meters).

amp.name: Improved Accuracy
amp.narrative: Changes one of the ranges of a weapon type (to be chosen) from "Disadvantage" to "OK" or from "–" to "Disadvantage".

amp.name: Improved Sense
amp.narrative: Allows you to choose a narrative effect (night vision, thermographic vision, extended auditory spectrum, canine sense of smell, echolocation, etc.).

amp.name: Linguistics
amp.narrative: Allows the character to absorb a language so they can speak it for the rest of the scene in exchange for one Edge point.

amp.name: Magic Sense
amp.narrative: The character can sense magical activity (foci, active spells, mana barriers, astral forms) around themselves, even if they are not in astral perception. Treat this ability as a Detect Magic spell casted with Logic + Perception (astral).

amp.name: Mental Resistance
amp.narrative: +1 Mental armor

amp.name: Missile Mastery
amp.narrative: In the hands of the adept, the most innocuous object becomes a throwing weapon (DV: S+0, Range [OK/OK/-/-].

amp.name: Missile Parry
amp.narrative: The character can catch a thrown weapon that they managed to dodge in exchange for an Edge point.

amp.name: Nerve Strike
amp.narrative: Instead of dealing damage in unarmed combat, the character can spends one Edge point and paralyzes their opponent, preventing them from using their next action (they can, however, still spend one Edge point to gain an additional action).

amp.name: Smashing blow
amp.narrative: DV+4 to unarmed attack when the character hits a barrier or static structure.

amp.name: Spirit Claw
amp.narrative: In exchange for one Edge point, the character can create a spiritual short or long weapon (their choice). This weapon is considered magical and affects targets immune to normal weapons.

amp.name: Strong Spirit Claw
amp.narrative: In exchange for one Edge point, the character can create a spiritual short or long weapon (their choice) with a +2 to its base DV. This weapon is considered magical and affects targets immune to normal weapons.

amp.name: Sustenance
amp.narrative: Allows the character to go several days without food or water without suffering any Disadvantage.

amp.name: Traceless Walk
amp.narrative: When the character walks on dust, snow, water, a pressure sensor or any other surface, they leave no trace, as if it had never been there.

amp.name: True Sight
amp.narrative: The threshold for the character to be affected by an illusion is increased by 1.

amp.name: Wall Running
amp.narrative: Allows you to move for a short distance on a vertical surface.

amp.name: Weapon focus (knife)
amp.narrative: Short weapon (DV Str+1, OK/-/-/-). Can be used in astral projection (DV Cha+1) and ignores immunity to normal weapons.

amp.name: Weapon focus (katana)
amp.narrative: Long weapon (DV Str+2, OK/-/-/-). Can be used in astral projection (DV Cha+2) and ignores immunity to normal weapons.

amp.name: Fixed
amp.narrative: Can’t move

amp.name: Removed Manual Controls
amp.narrative: Allows you to replace the vehicle's standard controls (steering wheel and pedals, for example) with 100% wireless controls. Obviously, this does not work for drones.

amp.name: Additional Autosofts Fuzzy Logic
amp.narrative: Improves the Pilot. Max improvement +6 or up to a Pilot rating of 12.

amp.name: Additional Mount
amp.narrative: Allows the addition of one extra weapon, limited by the drone's size. This is at the GM's discretion. Does not take the weapon's cost into account.

amp.name: Additional plates Reinforcements
amp.narrative: Improve vehicle armor by +1. Max +Body of the vehicle.

amp.name: Amenities
amp.narrative: Converts part of the vehicle's passenger compartment or storage space into living space (kitchen area, sleeping area, etc.). The vehicle must, of course, be of sufficient size.

amp.name: Amphibious Operation Upgrade
amp.narrative: Makes the vehicle amphibious.

amp.name: Ares Lock & Engage Aiming Assistance Software
amp.narrative: Allows the Pilot or jumped in Rigger to benefit from

amp.name: Ares Rigger’s Cocoon
amp.narrative: Transforms the rigger's position into a padded ballistic chamber, providing additional protection.

amp.name: Ares Rigger’s Guardian Angel
amp.narrative: Transforms the rigger's position into a padded ballistic chamber, providing additional protection. Biomonitor Automatically injects a stim patch in case of Serious Wound and a trauma patch in case of an incapacitating wound

amp.name: Concealed Mount
amp.narrative: Allows you to camouflage an existing weapon mount. This is at the GM's discretion.

amp.name: Double Image Screens
amp.narrative: Allows the display of a realistic trid-like image of the interior (or exterior), which can, for example, conceal a passenger. You must take an action to observe and succeed on a Perception (Physical) Test against a Threshold of 3 to notice the deception – without being able to see what's behind it.

amp.name: Enhanced Double Image Screens
amp.narrative: Works like Double Image Screen, but with a Threshold of 4 to prevent being fooled.

amp.name: Drone Rack
amp.narrative: Allows for the transport and deployment of a drone (smaller than the vehicle).

amp.name: ECM
amp.narrative: The vehicle is equipped with Electronic Counter Measures that generate selective jamming, affecting both Cracking and sensor lock attempts. Requires an Engineering (Electronic warfare) Test against a Threshold of 0 to generate Noise. Net hits are used as the Threshold to bypass the Jamming Effects.

amp.name: ECCM
amp.narrative: The vehicle is equipped with Electronic Counter-Counter Measures. This allows it to gain an Advantage in Tests designed to circumvent jamming at the cost of one Edge point.

amp.name: Ejection Seats
amp.narrative: The vehicle is equipped with ejection seats.

amp.name: Electromagnetic Shielding
amp.narrative: Reduces damage inflicted by a Zapper road strip, from severe to light.

amp.name: Engine Customization Rich Fuel Mix / Better Cells
amp.narrative: Improves speed, max +3.

amp.name: EnviroSeal™
amp.narrative: The EnviroSeal™ life support system allows for filtration of the air diffused into the passenger compartment to maintain a completely healthy environment and, in extreme cases, to isolate it completely airtight while maintaining a constant pressure.

amp.name: Evasive systems
amp.narrative: Allows the Pilot or cold-sim jumped-in Riggers to gain an Advantage for defensive maneuvers in exchange for one Edge point (note: riggers in hot sim receive an Advantage for all their defensive tests for free).

amp.name: Eyecatching
amp.narrative: The vehicle's aesthetic modifications cannot go unnoticed.

amp.name: Flying
amp.narrative: Flying Double the base Speed (1 if speed was 0)

amp.name: Gyro Linked Mount
amp.narrative: Provides optimal firing conditions for the gunner by absorbing recoil and compensating for changes in direction. RR 1 Ranged combat (Mounted weapons) or RR 1 Engineering (Remote- controlled weapons) for automated mount.

amp.name: Identical additional drone
amp.narrative: Max 3 identical drones (you can buy more at its normal cost).

amp.name: Improved Sensor Array
amp.narrative: Allows the pilot or rigger inside the vehicle to benefit from low light vision, thermographic vision, and radar/sonar.

amp.name: NTech Sensors
amp.narrative: Allows the pilot or rigger inside the vehicle to benefit from low light vision, thermographic vision, and radar/sonar.

amp.name: Mimic
amp.narrative: It gives a realistic appearance to an anthropomorphic drone; this includes synthetic skin and hair, and sometimes more, in the case of dolls…

amp.name: Nitrous Injection
amp.narrative: Allows you to gain an Advantage on a Piloting Test involving speed for a limited time in exchange for one Edge point.

amp.name: Off-Road Tires and Off-Road Configuration
amp.narrative: This helps avoid a Disadvantage when piloting on rough terrain.

amp.name: Oil-Slick Sprayer
amp.narrative: In exchange for an Edge point, sprays a sheet of teflon-powdered oil onto the street, making it extremely slippery and giving a Disadvantage to pursuers.

amp.name: Pilot Safety Override
amp.narrative: Allows the Pilot to take more risk than a low-risk.

amp.name: Ram Plate
amp.narrative: Allows the vehicle to be used as a weapon. Requires an opposed Piloting (vehicle type) Test. DV: Vehicle's Body + Speed difference between vehicles at the moment of impact (speeds are additive in a head-on collision) + 2 due to the ram plate. The attacking vehicle also takes damage equal to a DV of the target’s vehicle's Body (or Strength if it is a character) + the speed difference between vehicles. Net hits achieved during the maneuver can be used either to increase the Attack's DV or to reduce the DV taken.

amp.name: Road Strip Ejector
amp.narrative: Allows the ejection of road strips. There are two types of road strip: • Spike Strip, designed to puncture the tires of a pursuing vehicle for an Edge point, thus imposing a Disadvantage in driving Tests. • Zapper Strip, designed to damage the internal components of the vehicle that passes over them for an Edge point. The vehicle then suffers Serious Damage (minor damage if it has electromagnetic protection).

amp.name: Robotic arm
amp.narrative: Allows the manipulation of objects at a distance, and can accommodate integrated equipment (or weapons) depending on its size and the size of the vehicle.

amp.name: Sidecar
amp.narrative: Adds a sidecar to a motorcycle. +1 Structure -1 Handling The sidecar can be modified to add a weapon mount or a drone rack.

amp.name: Slick Tire and Race Configuration
amp.narrative: Allows you to gain an Advantage during a chase on a dry, well-maintained road in exchange for one Edge point. Allows you to gain one Edge point at the cost of a Disadvantage on driving Tests as long as the vehicle does not return to a dry road.

amp.name: Smart Armor
amp.narrative: Increases armor by 2 in exchange for one Edge point, then useless until repaired.

amp.name: Smart Suspension
amp.narrative: Improves handling, max +3.

amp.name: Smoke Projector
amp.narrative: Allows you to saturate an area with thick smoke (or thermal smoke) that could impose a visibility Disadvantage.

amp.name: Smuggling Compartment
amp.narrative: Popular with smugglers, this compartment allows the concealment of equipment. Its size depends on the vehicle's dimensions and represents between 10 and 20% of the initial storage space. Locating the compartment requires a successful Perception (Physical) Test against a Threshold of 4. Some sensors provide an Advantage on this Test.

amp.name: Stealth
amp.narrative: The vehicle is coated with an absorbent material or paint designed to reduce its visual, thermal, and radar signature.

amp.name: Transponder Tampering
amp.narrative: Allows the vehicle to switch between multiple vehicle identifiers on the XGuide™ network or on radar screens. Includes smart paint/materials that allow the vehicle's license plate number to be changed with a simple electrical command.

amp.name: Turret conversion
amp.narrative: Allows you to convert a weapon mount into a turret. This is at the GM's discretion.

amp.name: VTOL Capacity
amp.narrative: Allows a large flying drone to take off and land vertically; without it, the drone needs space. Medium and smaller flying drones do not need this modification for vertical take-off and landing.

amp.name: Yamaha Motorcycle Gyro Stabilization
amp.narrative: Allows a motorcycle to remain upright even without a kickstand and provides emergency compensation in case of a fall. Grants an Advantage against an Edge point during maneuvers that could cause a fall. Also allows the rider to perform other tasks (such as shooting) without Disadvantage when driving.
